verdict.rationale: A system-to-system channel with published enrollment is a fair question for a government immigration service, so the axis applies. The pack only shows human-facing portals and accounts (GCKey, representative and employer accounts), with no documented API, transmitter program, batch provider or system-account enrollment path. Those accounts are an adjacent feature for people, not a machine channel, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
